full_prompt_en: A square painterly portrait shows a blond boy leaning forward with his face close to the viewer. His bent forearm crosses the lower center, and his chin rests just above his hand, which partly covers his mouth. He looks toward the left side of the frame with a serious, watchful expression. His light hair is built from broad strokes of cream, ocher, gray-green, and pale blue, brushed in loose directions across the crown and forehead. The face is recognizable but not smoothly finished: cheek, nose, brow, and ear are assembled from angular daubs of peach, rust, ivory, olive, and cool blue shadow. One ear stands out along the right edge of the head. The eyes are darkly framed and remain the most precise details. A teal-green shirt or jacket fills the lower half, made from wide intersecting strokes of deep turquoise, bottle green, white, and nearly black. The sleeves and folded arms form a dense horizontal base beneath the face. Behind him is a mostly off-white ground with a few thin drips, scratches, and scattered marks. Directional light from the upper left catches the hair, forehead, upper cheek, and forearm, while broken cool shadows define the jaw and folds. Thick and thin paint coexist, with ridges, scraped passages, and small exposed areas of the pale ground. The crop is close and cuts the lower arms at the bottom edge. The composition sets an inward, still pose against lively fragmented brushwork and a restrained warm-cool palette.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画肖像描绘一名金发男孩身体前倾，面孔靠近观者。弯曲的前臂横过下部中央，下巴靠在手的上方，手遮住一部分嘴。他看向画面左侧，神情严肃而警觉。浅发由奶油色、赭黄、灰绿和淡蓝的宽笔触构成，松散地朝不同方向掠过头顶和前额。脸庞可辨，却并非平滑收尾：颊、鼻、眉和耳朵由桃色、锈色、象牙白、橄榄色与冷蓝阴影的棱角笔痕拼起。一只耳朵在头部右边格外突出。眼睛被深色围住，是最精确的细节。蓝绿色上衣或外套占据下半幅，以深青、瓶绿、白色和近黑的宽笔触交叉构成。衣袖和交叠的手臂在脸下形成密实的水平基底。身后大多是灰白底，只有几道细滴痕、刮线和零散痕迹。左上方定向光照亮头发、额头、上脸颊与前臂，断续冷阴影界定下颌和褶面。厚薄颜料并存，有隆起笔脊、刮擦区域和少量露出的浅底。裁切紧凑，在底边截去下段手臂。构图以内敛静止的姿态对照活跃破碎的笔触和克制的冷暖色盘。
style_prompt_en: Painting uses broad, broken strokes and selective scraping to build volume from color fragments rather than polished blending. Keep a pale exposed ground around the focal mass, with spare drips and hairline marks that reveal the painting process. Mix warm ivory, peach, ocher, and rust with cool teal, turquoise, olive, and blue-gray shadow. A few precise dark details anchor an otherwise loose surface. Light arrives directionally from above one side, catching ridges of pale pigment and leaving cool broken shadow in recesses. Crop close and let interlocking strokes create both the focal form and a broad base beneath it. The transferable effect is immediate and expressive, balancing legible structure with energetic unfinished edges and tactile paint.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画通过宽阔断续的笔触与局部刮擦，以颜色碎片而非平滑晕染建立体积。焦点形体周围保留浅色露底，稀疏滴痕和发丝般细线显露作画过程。把暖象牙白、桃色、赭黄和锈色与冷青绿、蓝绿、橄榄色及蓝灰阴影混合。少量准确深色细节锚定其余松散表面。光从一侧上方定向落下，照亮浅色颜料的隆起笔脊，并在凹处留下破碎冷影。裁切靠近，让互相嵌合的笔触既形成焦点形体，也在下方构成宽阔基底。可迁移的效果即时而富表现力，在可辨结构、活跃未完成边缘与可触颜料之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A thoughtful boy resting his chin above folded arms
theme_zh: 一个若有所思的男孩把下巴靠近交叠手臂
name: Simon Birch
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
